system.description:
A Jonin wearing the Cloud Villages vest, being confronted by an adversarial village as he’s been caught alone without any allies to back him up. He tries to make a move to escape, but he is quickly stopped by more enemies around him. “You think it was smart to go out alone huh?” the enemy shinobi speaks rather directly and aggressively. The Jonin grits his teeth, before he quickly weaves hand seals. The adversarial shinobi leaps back scattering in random directions saying “Can’t Fire in unorthodox directions now can Y~”. They are quickly cut off by beams of bending Lightning that tears through them all.

—Ren Nara

At Worlds End, Ch. 7 excerpt.

Laser Focused

The Ranton Clan is a clan that hails proudly from the Land of Lightning. Known to work closely with the Raikage, but not limited to that one country. Their bloodline has spread widely throughout the continent, they are for sure reliable allies, and even greater enemies. When given a task, they are usually focused to a fault, on accomplishing a goal.

Ranton Traits

Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Dex, +1 int

Speed: 35 feet.

Skill Proficiencies: Nature, (Athletics or Chakra Control, pick one).

Storm Release Affinity: You begin with either Water or Lightning Release affinity. (Pick one)

Storm Techniques: The Ranton Clan has access to a separate list of Jutsu unique to their Clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the Normal jutsu list(s). They do not need both Nature Release’s to use their Clan jutsu.

Hijutsu Flexibility: Ranton Clan Hijutsu can use either Dexterity or Intelligence as its casting ability score.

Branch Family: The Ranton are split between two different branches, the [Storm Branch] and the [Reezaa Branch]. The storm branch are warrior who enhance their physical body with lightning release, in the form of a chakra cloak reinforcing their durability and strength. The Reezaa branch is capable of creating flexible beams of energy that can curve and shift direction. This determines some clan features or which Hijutsu you gain/have access to. This cannot be changed later

Ranton Features

Gale Style

1st Level Clan Feature, [Reezaa Branch]

Lightning is many things, if not predicable. But your job is to make the lightning unpredictable. You know how to shift the consistency of lightning into that of water, allowing you to bend beams of energy around corners. This is represented by a unique for of combat that your branch of the clan can utilize, your Laser Circus Chakra stance.

As a bonus action, you can enter this Laser Circus chakra stance. While in this stance, you gain the following benefits;

When you take the attack action or cast a Ranton Clan Hijutsu that requires an attack, you can choose to replace any number of attacks made with the action with a Laser Circus attack. Beginning at 7th level, if you do not have the Extra Attack feature, when you take the Attack action while in this stance, you can attack twice with your Laser Circus attack, instead of once. Beginning at 15th level, you can attack three times instead of twice.

Laser Circus. Make a ranged jutsu attack using your highest jutsu attack bonus against a creature you can see within 60 feet of you, dealing 1d10 lightning damage on a hit. If you roll an 8 or higher on the damage die of this attack, the target creature is marked as a Refraction Point.

Storm Incarnate

1st Level Clan Feature, [Storm Branch]

The legacy of the Raikage flows through your veins. You may be a decedent or student, but it flows through you the same. Others use Lightning as a weapon, you have learned to use it as your shield, and sword. This is represented by a unique battle form where you augment yourself in a coat of lightning, your Storm Force state.

When you enter initiative, you can activate your Storm Force state, which has two variants, the Spear and Shield forms, which lasts until the end of combat. You choose which form you enter at the beginning of combat, and can switch your chosen form as a Bonus action on your turn.

While in your Storm Force state, you build Voltage, a special resource that is stored as an electrical force within your body that you can convert into combat momentum. You begin each combat with 0 Voltage, and can build up to 4 Voltage. This increases to 5 at 7th and 6 at 15th levels. You can gain 1 Voltage per trigger, per turn, if you; Take damage from a hostile creature, deal lightning damage to a hostile creature or succeed on a saving throw vs a hostile effect. You can spend this Voltage when an effect calls for it.

Spear Form

Your attacks become the ultimate spear, able to penetrate any defense and overwhelm anyone that dares to try and clash with you. Your unarmed and weapon attacks can deal Lightning damage. Melee attacks you make as a result of Hijutsu you cast gain a +1 bonus to their attack rolls and a +2 bonus to their damage rolls. Beginning at 7th level, this expands to your Unarmed and Weapon attacks that deal Lightning damage as well. Beginning at 15th level, the bonus to attacks increases to +2 and the bonus to damage becomes +4.

Shield Form

Your lightning acts as the ultimate shield, covering your entire body, protecting you like a suit of armor. You gain resistance to Lightning damage, and temporary hit points equal to 4 times your current Voltage, at the beginning of each of your turns.

If you cast a jutsu with the Lightning or Water release keywords, on the turn you gain temporary hit points, you can gain additional temporary hit points equal to your current Voltage. This is in addition to the temporary hit points gained by this feature, up to twice per turn.

Gale Circuit

3rd Level Clan Feature, [Reezaa Branch]

Your precision with Storm release is amplified by your attention to detail. You have learned to bend, split and amplify your lightning release in ways that defy conventional geometry. This is represented as Circuits, of which you can select 2 from the following list. You gain 1 additional Circuit at 7th and 15th levels.

Rapid Fire

While in Laser Circus stance, if you take the Attack Action to make Laser Circus attacks, you can also spend your Bonus action, to make 1 additional Laser Circus attack. This increases to two attacks at 7th level and three attacks at 15th level.

| Refraction Point / [Elemental] / A creature marked as a Refraction Point has been saturated with Storm Release chakra, and their body acts as a Prism for the Laser Circus technique. / When a creature marked as a Refraction Point takes damage from a ranged attack as a result of a Ranton Hijutsu or a Laser Circus attack, the attack is refracted. The nearest creature within 30 feet of the Refraction Point, that is hostile to the Ranton that inflicted this condition becomes a target, immediately taking half the damage the Refraction Point took. This condition then immediately ends. / If a creature marked as a Refraction Point takes damage as a result of another creature that is marked as a Refraction Point, the next nearest creature takes damage equal to half the damage the original target took. This effect can only occur up to 4 times per turn. / The original Refraction Point, can never be affected by this chaining effect. / Creatures immune to both Lightning and Cold damage are immune to this condition. |

Prismatic Split

When you score a hit with a Laser Circus attack against a creature marked as a Refraction Point, the creature affected by the Refraction Point damage chain is also marked as Refraction Point’s for the next minute.

Cold Snap

Once per turn, when you deal cold damage to a creature as a result of a jutsu you cast with the Water release keyword, you can spread water particles surrounding them until the end of your next turn. If you target this creature with a Laser Circus, the first missed attack can be remade as you refract the laser off of the scattered water particles.

Beginning at 7th level, if the water release jutsu cast deals damage and can inflict an Elemental condition, you can choose to instead mark the affected creature as a Refraction Point for the next minute, even if they pass their saving throw.

Static Arc

Once per turn, when you deal lightning damage to a creature, you can spend your Bonus action to release an arc of electricity targeting one creature you can see within 20 feet of the original target, forcing them to make a Dexterity saving throw, vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, they gain the Shocked condition and are marked as a Refraction Point for the next minute.

Cascade

Once per turn, when you deal both Cold and Lightning damage to a creature, you can crystalize the charged lightning in the air around them. Until the end of your next turn, if that creature willingly moves more than 5 feet, or casts a jutsu with the Mobility (M) component, they take three times your Laser Circus attacks damage and must make a Constitution saving throw, being Stunned, until the end of their current turn on a failure.

Prismatic Overloads

As you strike the same creatures with Laser Circus attacks, they become charged with your electrical energy before it surges out in shockwave.

Once per turn at the conclusion of Laser Circus attacks as a result of your Action and Bonus action, count the number of successful attacks and inflict any one effect based on those successful attacks. If an effect forces a saving throw, use your highest jutsu save DC.

2+ Attacks: Once per turn, an affected creature makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, energy overloads, causing them to be Dazed and Weakened.

3+ Attacks: Once per turn, an affected creature becomes the center of a shape of your choice (20-foot radius, 30-foot cone, 60-foot long, 5-foot-wide line) The chosen shape erupts from them forcing all creatures in this new area to make a Dexterity saving throw, inflicting the Bruised and Slowed condition on a failure.

5+ Attacks: Once per turn, an affected creature is overwhelmed by the number of concurrent hits, forcing them to make a Constitution saving throw, being Stunned on a failure.

Storm Circuit

3rd Level Clan Feature, [Storm Branch]

Your connection to black lightning has deepened beyond the surface level Storm Force, your foes have come to know you for. You have learned to push your Storm Force state into specialized expressions, spending Voltage on different effects. Abilities that force saving throws use your highest jutsu save DC. This is represented as Circuits, of which you can select 2 from the following list. You gain 1 additional Circuit at 7th and 15th levels.

Black Thunder

Once per turn, on your turn, you can spend 1 Voltage. When you do, reduce your remaining speed by 10, and then select a space you can see within 30 feet of you, teleporting into the chosen space as a flash of lightning. Until the beginning of your next turn, the first attack made against you by a creature within 10 feet of the space you teleported to is made at disadvantage.

Beginning at 7th level, if you make a melee attack immediately after teleporting in this way, you make that first melee attack at advantage.

Grounded

While in your Storm Force state, by spending up to 4 Voltage, until the end of the current turn, ranged attacks that deal lightning or cold damage, that target an allied creature within 60 feet of you, can be rerouted to you, forcing the attack to instead be treated as if you were the original target.

Additionally, until the end of the current turn, you gain immunity to the Shocked and Chilled conditions and temporary hit points equal to 4 times the number of Voltage spent until the end of the current turn. This is in addition to any gained by the Shield Form.

Spear of Heaven

While you are in Spear Form, once per turn, as part of dealing damage with a melee Ninjutsu or Taijutsu attack that deals Lightning damage, you can spend 3 Voltage. If you do, you release a spike of electrical energy from your strike, forcing the target to make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, they take an additional 2d6 lightning damage and are also Dazed, or half as much on a success. Beginning at 7th level, increase the bonus damage to 4d6 and the target is also Staggered. Beginning at 15th level, increase the bonus damage to 6d6 and lightning damage you deal as part of the triggering attack and this Circuit ignores resistance and treat immunity as resistance.

Shield of Thunder

While you are in Shield Form, once per turn, when you take damage as the result of an attack, you can spend your Reaction and 2 Voltage. When you do, you erect barriers of lightning in front of you, granting it 2d6 plus your level in hit points. This barrier lasts until the end of the current turn.

Beginning at 11th level, this barrier gains immunity to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage.

Storm Drain

As a Bonus action, by spending 2 Voltage, you can create a field of dominance around you, consuming all ranks of Shocked from all creatures within 30 feet of you. For every rank of Shocked consumed in this way, roll 1d4. You gain temporary chakra equal to the result, until the end of your next turn.

Beginning at 7th level, if a hostile creature in range is under the effect of a jutsu with the Lightning Release keyword, that is granting then a bonus or positive benefit, they must make a Constitution saving throw, having that effect dispelled on a failure.

Beginning at 15th level, if a hostile creature in range, is under the effect of a jutsu with a nature release keyword, they must make the Constitution saving throw.

Beast of Lightning

When you summon a creature as a result of a Jutsu you cast with the Lightning or Water Release keyword, by spending 2 Voltage as part of casting the triggering jutsu they surge with power, as they become pitch black and radiate with energy. For the summoned creatures duration, they gain additional hit points equal to your level, and +1 AC. This increases to +2 AC and Resistance to Earth and Fire damage at 7th level and +3 AC and Immunity to Elemental conditions at 15th level.

Storm Release Manifestation - Reezaa

7th Level Clan Feature, [Reezaa Branch]

The Ranton clan has a unique talent for manifesting Storm Release due to their close affinity to both Lightning and Water Release. You gain the second Nature release you didn’t select from Storm Release Affinity clan trait and when casting a jutsu with either Cold or Lightning release keywords, you can change the damage type to Water or Lightning respectively.

Additionally, when you enter initiative, you can activate the Storm Force state, you can enter this Storm Force state, but you can only access the Spear Form which lasts until the end of combat. This version of the Spear Form does not gain the 7th or 15th level benefits for the feature.

Storm Release Manifestation - Storm

7th Level Clan Feature, [Storm Branch]

The Ranton clan has a unique talent for manifesting Storm Release due to their close affinity to both Lightning and Water Release. You gain the second Nature release you didn’t select from Storm Release Affinity clan trait and when casting a jutsu with either Cold or Lightning release keywords, you can change the damage type to Cold or Lightning respectively.

Additionally, when you take the attack action or cast a Ranton Clan Hijutsu that requires an attack, you can choose to replace any number of attacks made with the action with a Laser Circus attack.

Laser Circus. Make a ranged jutsu attack using your highest jutsu attack bonus against a creature you can see within 60 feet of you, dealing 1d10 lightning damage on a hit. If you roll an 8 or higher on the damage die of this attack, the target creature is marked as a Refraction Point.

Static Network

11th Level Clan Feature

You learn to weave invisible threads of storm release chakra between yourself and your allies, establishing an invisible communication network.

At the completion of a long rest, you and up to 5 allied creatures gain special chakra made communication devices infused into each creatures chakra network until your next long rest. Each creature with this network, can transmit things they say and hear to other creatures on this network so long as they are within 1 mile of them.

Additionally, while linked if any one creature would be Surprised, all other members are not surprised if part of the same initiative.

Eye of the Storm

15th Level Clan Feature

The most dangerous storms are the ones that form suddenly with no warning. You have learned to suppress the visible expression of your Storm Release entirely, spreading it across the battlefield, as you create a network of electrical nodes that only you can fully perceive.

As a Bonus action, you can activate this invisible network as you begin to control a 60-foot radius centered on you, for the next minute. This field moves with you and cannot be detected unless a creature has Chakra sense or Chakra sight. You can use this feature once per long rest.

For the duration you gain the following benefits:

Storm Awareness. You know the location of every creature within this radius, regardless of concealment, invisibility or darkness. Even if you cannot see them, these creatures can always be targeted with your Laser Circus attack even if behind Cover.

Interference Field. Hostile creatures in the affected area must make a Constitution saving throw at the beginning of their turns vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure If they cast a Ninjutsu or Genjutsu that does not have the Lightning or Water release keywords, that jutsu’s cost is increased by +4 until the beginning of their next turn.

Grounded Surge. Hostile creatures that are Shocked or Chilled on your turn, suffer a -2 penalty to their saving throws against Ranton Hijutsu you cast.
